# Joseph Frimpong
Postdoctoral Researcher · Argonne National Laboratory  
Email: frimpsjoe@anl.gov · GitHub: [frimpsjoek](https://github.com/frimpsjoek){target="_blank"} · LinkedIn: [josephfrimpong](https://linkedin.com/in/josephfrimpong){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.cv-summary}
Computational chemist developing AI/ML-accelerated many-body electronic-structure methods (GW/BSE) and high-performance workflows to speed up materials discovery for catalysis, optoelectronics, and energy applications.
:::

## Appointments

- **Postdoctoral Researcher**, Argonne National Laboratory, Lemont, IL — Nov 2024 – present  
  AI/ML for electronic-structure calculations; Midwest Integrated Center for Computational Materials (MICCoM). Advisors: Maria Chan and Giulia Galli.
- **Schaap-Rumble Research Fellow & Graduate Research Assistant**, Wayne State University, Detroit, MI — Sept 2020 – July 2024  
  GW/BSE methods for large heterogeneous interfaces; quantum dots, covalent organic frameworks, and molecule–metal interfaces. Advisor: Zhen-Fei Liu.
- **Data Analyst (project)**, Wayne State University — Sept 2022 – May 2023
- **Physics Teacher**, Tamale Senior High School, Ghana — Nov 2018 – Aug 2019
- **Research Assistant**, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Ghana — May 2016 – Aug 2018  
  Advisors: Caroline Kwawu and Evans Adei.

## Projects

- **Atomic Shorts** — an agentic AI system that makes short videos explaining complex materials-science concepts (LLM Hackathon Visionary Award, 2025).
- **MCP server for Quantum ESPRESSO** — runs Quantum ESPRESSO calculations from any LLM client, locally with Docker or remotely through Globus Compute (Polaris endpoint).

## Technical Profile

- **Methods:** DFT, GW/BSE, many-body perturbation theory, dielectric embedding, QM/MM, generative and graph-based deep learning.
- **Electronic-structure codes:** Quantum ESPRESSO, WEST, BerkeleyGW, VASP, PySCF, Gaussian, TeraChem, AMBER, GROMACS.
- **Machine learning & data:** PyTorch (DDP, multi-node GPU training), PyTorch Geometric, Horovod, Weights & Biases, NumPy, pandas, pymatgen, Matminer, DeepChem.
- **HPC:** Perlmutter, Polaris, Aurora, ACCESS (Bridges, Expanse), Carbon; MPI, OpenMP, Slurm/PBS.
- **Programming & DevOps:** Python, Bash, C++, Fortran, MATLAB, R, Git, CI/CD, Docker.
